name: bumblebee
description: Supply-chain threat intelligence plugin: pinned Bumblebee scanner wrapped as a governed, policy-gated Allura agent tool for read-only package inventory and vulnerability exposure.

interface.shortDescription: Supply-chain threat intelligence via governed scanner integration.
interface.longDescription: Bumblebee wraps a pinned upstream scanner (perplexityai/bumblebee v0.1.2) as a deterministic, policy-gated Allura agent tool. It provides read-only supply-chain inventory, vulnerability exposure intelligence, and downstream handoff to Allura's exposure and governed-response services with zero-trust, fail-closed gates at every stage.
